'''Haupia''' is a Hawaiian [[Cookbook:Pudding|pudding]] made of coconut milk and cornstarch (originally Polynesian [[Cookbook:Arrowroot|arrowroot]] starch).
== Ingredients ==
* 3 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Coconut Milk|coconut milk]]
* ½ cup white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 1 dash [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
== Procedure ==
# Mix coconut milk with sugar and salt over a medium heat.
# Slowly add cornstarch and stir until thickened.
# Pour into a pan or square form.
# Cool for 1 hour or until fully set.
# Unmold and cut into squares.
